# GLP-1 Forum

> Community forum for discussing GLP-1 medications, peptide sourcing, dosing protocols, side effects, and weight loss experiences with Tirzepatide, Semaglutide, and emerging compounds.

GLP-1 Forum serves as a discussion hub for users of GLP-1 receptor agonists like Mounjaro, Zepbound, and research peptides. The community shares vendor experiences, testing results, dosing strategies, and side effect management while navigating the evolving landscape of prescription shortages and compounding pharmacies.

## Key Topics

- GLP-1 receptor agonists
- Tirzepatide (Mounjaro/Zepbound)
- Semaglutide
- Peptide sourcing and vendors
- Dosing protocols and titration
- Side effects management
- Group buy testing and quality control
- Weight loss strategies
- Peptide stacking and rotation
- Tesofensine
- Mazdutide
- Medication shortages
- Compounding pharmacies
- Vendor reviews and warnings
